title: Prototype 2
shortDescription: Prototype 2 helps define a PC (Windows) action and adventure path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Offers a clearly labeled action and adventure route through the PC (Windows) collection.
Separates the GameAtlas catalog method from the external factual reference.
